title: %trim - strip leading and trailing whitespace
purpose: Remove whitespace from both ends of a string.
input:
raw = "  hello  "
spaced = "  a b c  "
tabbed = "\thi\t"
notes: Trims both ends; interior whitespace is left untouched.
The argument must be a reference (@.raw) or a quoted literal.

avoid.why: missing the source argument - the engine raises a verb-arity error
